newsitem.title: UK: Reuters has electronic broker research link.
newsitem.headline: Reuters has electronic broker research link.

text.p: News and information group Reuters Holdings Plc said on Monday its UK and Ireland unit had launched its electronic research service, Reuters Broker Research (RBR).
RBR allows stockbroker analysts to distribute research instantaneously to their sales desks and fund manager clients worldwide, in its original full colour "as published" format.

RBR is a global product distributing equity, debt and economic research and analysis from the world's established and emerging markets. It will enable brokers to reduce their printing and distribution costs and deliver research to their clients much faster than existing methods.

"RBR's worldwide database of broker research and analysis complements the wealth of historical, fundamental and technical data provided by the Reuters 3000 product range, launched earlier this year," said Martin Cole, marketing director of Reuters UK and Ireland.
"It will also substantially reduce the existing massive paper-intensive operation," he added.
